name: chat-message
purpose: One message in a generative AI conversation (Cloudscape's chat bubble, AI Elements' Message): the content and — once the response is complete — the action row a reader uses on it (copy, the a Feedback menu with good / bad response, read aloud, share, try again, branch in new chat, the sources), and on the reader's own prompt Copy and Edit. It owns the message lifecycle: `pending` (waiting for the first token: the loading text), `streaming` (content arriving, busy, no actions), `success` (actions shown; announced once to screen readers through the `Conversation`) and `error` (an error line with Try again). Assistant messages are plain text across the reading column at the prose reading size (`.text-body-prose-md`, 16 px on 26 px lines): no avatar, name, time or bubble. User messages are a filled bubble at the inline end, at most 70 % wide; system messages a muted centered line. A user message opens for editing (`v-model:editing`) and Send emits `edit` with the new text for the app's `setMessages` and `sendMessage`. Author and time live in the accessible name (the time also shows on hover over the user's bubble). Alignment comes from the enclosing `Conversation`.
useWhen: Every turn of a chat with the generative AI assistant: the person's prompt, the assistant's response, a system note ("Conversation restarted").
A response that must show its lifecycle (loading, streaming, failure) and its actions.
avoidWhen: A generated block outside a conversation (a summary on a page) → `StreamingResponse` alone.
A notification or toast about the product → `alert` / `toast`.
A comment thread between people → not this component; it carries AI semantics (feedback thumbs, regenerate).
related: `conversation` — the log that holds messages, sets alignment and announces finished ones.
`streaming-response` — the safe Markdown renderer for assistant content.
`reasoning`, `sources`, `tool-call`, `artifact-preview` — parts that stack inside an assistant message.
bestPractices: Pass `status` from your request: `pending` until the first token, `streaming` while tokens arrive, then `success` or `error`.

Turn on the built-in actions with props instead of composing buttons: `copyable`, `show-feedback`, `show-read-aloud`, `shareable`, `retryable`, `branchable` on a response; `copyable`, `editable` on a prompt. The row keeps one order and moves Good response, Bad response and Try again into More when it is narrow.
Put the `Sources` pill in `#trailing` (it stays on the same line) and a `ResponseBranches` pager in `#leading` once a response or prompt has versions.
Raise a toast after a rating, and open `FeedbackReasonDialog` after Bad response; the row itself shows no confirmation text.
Use `grouped` for a second message by the same author so stacked messages read as one turn.
Never put the feedback thumbs on non-AI content.

props.name: from
props.doc: Who wrote the message: the person (`user`), the generative AI assistant, or the product (`system`).

props.name: author
props.doc: Author name read in the message's accessible name; it is not shown. Empty uses the locale catalog (`You`, `AI assistant`, `System`).

props.name: timestamp
props.doc: Time the message was sent, already formatted for display (`10:42`). Added to the accessible name and shown on hover over the user's bubble.

props.name: status
props.doc: Lifecycle: `pending` shows the loading text, `streaming` marks the content busy, `success` shows the actions, `error` shows the error line with Try again.

props.name: grouped
props.doc: Follows a message by the same author: tightens the gap above it so stacked messages read as one turn.

props.name: errorMessage
props.doc: Error text shown while `status` is `error`. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.doc: Loading text shown while `status` is `pending`. Empty uses `ResponseLoading`'s own (`Generating a response`).

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The content: text, `StreamingResponse`, `Reasoning`, `Sources`, artifacts. Not rendered while `pending`.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: The action row, usually `ChatMessage.Actions`; shown only when `status` is `success`.
